oracle.description: templates/dispatch/tests/test_dispatch_release_secretscan.py decides correctness: three fixtures over one pure function, and nothing outside dispatch_release.py. Cut without re-authoring from the M-10 oracle written from the spec row by an author with no access to any implementation; the sample credentials are assembled from fragments at runtime so no secret-shaped literal sits in the file.

purpose: Add a module-level secret scan to templates/dispatch/scripts/dispatch_release.py. This is the first of the three packets M-10 was split into and it adds one pure function: nothing calls it yet. Name it scan_for_secrets. It takes text and returns a list of the NAMES of the patterns that matched -- never the matched text, and never any tail of it, because the finding goes into a report that may be read anywhere. Detect at minimum: GitHub tokens (ghp_, gho_, ghs_, ghu_, github_pat_), AWS access key ids (AKIA followed by 16 uppercase alphanumerics), PEM private-key headers (-----BEGIN ... PRIVATE KEY-----), Slack tokens (xoxb-, xoxa-, xoxp-, xoxr-, xoxs-), an Authorization: Bearer header whose value is 20 or more characters, and a generic assignment of api_key, token, secret or password to a value of 20 or more characters. The names must tell the kinds apart: two different kinds must not produce the same set of names, or the return value is a count with extra steps. Ordinary transcript prose returns an empty list -- a scan that fires on prose withholds every transcript, which is the same as never capturing one, so the false-positive side is as much of the requirement as the detection side. Change nothing else: PR_STEP_NAMES, STEPS, RETRY_STEPS, STOP_CONDITIONS, MAX_GATE_ATTEMPTS, pr_command, the L-4 retry, the L-2 stop conditions, the M-8 PR step and the M-9 commit all stay exactly as they are. Do not wire the scan into the PR step; that is M-10c.
required_outcomes: a module-level scan_for_secrets(text) exists on the driver
every pattern kind the spec enumerates is detected
a finding never carries the matched text or any tail of it
different kinds produce distinguishable name sets
ordinary transcript prose returns an empty list
nothing else in the driver changes, and no caller is added

acceptance_properties.requirement: the scan exists, detects every kind, and quotes nothing
acceptance_properties.fails_when: there is no module-level scan_for_secrets, a kind goes undetected, or a returned name contains the secret or its last twelve characters
two different kinds return the same set of names
ordinary prose or a generated worker transcript returns any finding

non_goals: the receipt capture and the sub-step naming, which are M-10c
the bounded PR body, which is M-10b
wiring the scan into the PR step, or any caller at all
